name: Antilles Current

sources.citation: Meinen et al. (2019), Structure and Variability of the Antilles Current at 26.5 N, doi:10.1029/2018JC014836
sources.locator: Introduction pp. 1-2; Table 1 p. 3; section 3.1; Table 3 p. 15; seasonal discussion and Fig. 11 pp. 17-18; Conclusions. PDF page numbers.
sources.supports: Regional mean northward flow at 26.5 N with subsurface peak and intermittent reversal; nominal instrument locations and a declared transport integration domain. Weak transport seasonality does not define route or width extrema.

sources.citation: Ingham (1975), Velocity and transport of the Antilles Current northeast of the Bahama Islands
sources.locator: Six sections near 28 degrees 35 minutes N
sources.supports: Older geographically distinct surface-flow assessment; cannot establish absence at every depth, place or time.

sources.citation: NOAA Tides and Currents Glossary, Antilles Current entry
sources.supports: General northwestward named flow along the northeastern Bahamas; no numerical endpoints.

scope_summary: Modern observations support mean northward flow at 26.5 N, distinct from the older northern surface-flow assessment. Neither study defines whole-current endpoint coordinates.

rejected_width_inference.source_locator: Table 3, coastline to site B transport-integration domain

source_access_note: Publisher full page returned 403; NOAA repository PDF read. No source curve digitized. Final AB0505 LADCP ASCII profiles and provider assessment were acquired separately in October 2026 and pinned with per-file checksums; this does not supply a longitudinal axis.
remaining_gates: Diagnose named-flow endpoints and representative velocity axis with declared layer and dates.
Specify a physical width boundary before deriving section widths; integration spans are a separate quantity.
Reconcile method-dependent velocity estimates before seasonal geometry and annual extrema.
Review updated scientific scope and rights before modifying the frozen release.

source_locator_correction.verification: Table heading and coastline-to-site-B row checked in NOAA repository and AOML copies; no Table 5 present in either text.

mean_structure_context.source_locator: Section 3.1 and Figure 2 caption; mean of 16 LADCP sections

transport_integration_domain.vertical_convention: surface to 1000 dbar or bottom where shallower

seasonal_context.source_locator: Seasonal discussion and Fig. 11, PDF pages 17-18
seasonal_context.qualifier: Weak seasonal component; large error bars; previous shorter-record cycle differs. No annual dimension extrema or dated axes inferred.

acquired_profile_context.summary: At fixed 400 m instrument depth, first May 2005 section is blocked by caution casts. Repeat has about 37 km sampled-peak-to-offshore-half-peak span, not full width. Source quality comments, unremoved tides, error velocities, missing-depth samples and cast times are retained. Whole-current and annual dimensions remain unresolved.
